name: Open Banking Consent and Payment Initiation — Happy Path
description: TPP completes DCR → posts domestic payment consent → customer authenticates via SCA and confirms → TPP initiates payment → sanctions and fraud checks both clear → FPS executes → account debited → TPP polls and receives AcceptedSettlementCompleted → customer notified. SVC-017 is a CHANNEL service outside the system boundary — it may call CAP-001 API synchronously.

Open Banking API Surface (CAP-007)

Retail Banking

201 Created { client_id: tpp-fintech-001, client_secret, token_endpoint, authorization_endpoint }

Publish EVT-058 ConsentRequested { consent_id, tpp_id }

Redirect browser to bank authorisation URL { client_id, response_type: code, scope: openid payments, state, request: <signed JAR JWT containing consent_id> }
GET /authorise (consent screen loads)

Display: 'Jane Smith is about to receive £150.00 from your account. Reference: INV-2024-001. Payee verified (CoP: match). [Confirm] [Decline]'

Initiate SCA challenge { customer_id, sca_method: biometric_mobile, dynamic_link: {amount: 150.00, payee_sort_code: 200000, payee_account_number: 12345678} }
Push notification: 'Confirm £150.00 to Jane Smith'
Biometric confirmation (Face ID / Touch ID)
SCA verified; dynamic linking confirmed

Atomic update: ENT-030.status = authorised; sca_completed = true; expires_at = now+90min

Browser follows redirect (delivers auth code to TPP)

Token introspection { access_token }
{ active: true, scope: payments, consent_id, sub: tpp-fintech-001 }

POST /payments { consent_id, amount: 150.00, currency: GBP, payee_sort_code: 200000, payee_account_number: 12345678, payee_name: Jane Smith, payment_reference: INV-2024-001, origination_channel: open_banking, tpp_id }
steps.note: Channel → Capability API (permitted). Must return payment_id synchronously (OBIE API contract)

steps.label: Validate ENT-030 (status=authorised, sca_completed=true, not expired, details match consent); validate ENT-004 Account (active, balance £2,340.00 >= £150.00, daily limit OK)

ATOMIC TRANSACTION: create ENT-008 PaymentIntent { payment_intent_id=pi-20260415-0042, consent_id, account_id, amount: 150.00, payee_sort_code: 200000, payee_account_number: 12345678, status: pending_screening }; update ENT-030.status=consumed
Publish EVT-179 PaymentIntentCreated { payment_intent_id: pi-20260415-0042, account_id, amount: 150.00, payee details }
Publish EVT-061 OpenBankingPaymentInitiated { payment_intent_id, consent_id, tpp_id }
Route EVT-061 → Notifications (SVC-053): Push to customer: 'Your Open Banking payment of £150.00 to Jane Smith is being processed'
201 Created { payment_intent_id: pi-20260415-0042 }
201 Created { Data: { DomesticPaymentId: pi-20260415-0042, ConsentId, Status: AcceptedSettlementInProcess } }
Consume EVT-179 PaymentIntentCreated → sanctions screen payee (OFSI, UN, EU, OFAC)
Consume EVT-179 PaymentIntentCreated → ML fraud scoring (features include tpp_id, consent_id)
steps.note: Cross-capability async — CAP-004 Risk Management; concurrent with CAP-005

steps.label: Publish EVT-180 SanctionsScreeningCompleted { payment_intent_id, outcome: clear }
Publish EVT-181 FraudScoreCompleted { payment_intent_id, risk_level: low }
Consume EVT-180 (outcome: clear) + EVT-181 (risk_level: low) — correlation on payment_intent_id
Publish EVT-182 PaymentCleared { payment_intent_id, account_id, amount: 150.00, payee_sort_code: 200000, payee_account_number: 12345678 }
Consume EVT-182 PaymentCleared → FPS submission
Create ENT-009 PaymentExecution { execution_id=pe-0042, payment_intent_id, status: fps_submitted }; construct ISO 20022 pacs.008 { UETR=<UUID>, InstrAmt: 150.00, Cdtr: Jane Smith, 200000/12345678 }
Submit pacs.008 to FPS
pacs.002 ACCP { FpsReference: FPS-20260415-09912, TxSts: ACCP }
Update ENT-009 status=settled, fps_reference=FPS-20260415-09912
Publish EVT-183 PaymentExecuted { payment_intent_id, execution_id, fps_reference: FPS-20260415-09912, settled_at }
Consume EVT-183 PaymentExecuted
Atomic debit: Account.available_balance -= 150.00; update daily_payment_total; set PaymentIntent.status=completed
Publish EVT-184 AccountDebited { account_id, amount: 150.00, fps_reference }
Publish EVT-062 OpenBankingPaymentCompleted { payment_intent_id, consent_id, tpp_id, fps_reference: FPS-20260415-09912, amount: 150.00, payee_name: Jane Smith, completed_at }
Route EVT-062 → Channel status cache: DomesticPaymentId → AcceptedSettlementCompleted
Route EVT-062 → Notifications (SVC-053): Push to PER-001: 'Payment of £150.00 to Jane Smith was successful. FPS Ref: FPS-20260415-09912'
GET /domestic-payments/pi-20260415-0042 Authorization: Bearer <access_token>
Read status cache: pi-20260415-0042 → AcceptedSettlementCompleted
200 OK { Data: { DomesticPaymentId: pi-20260415-0042, Status: AcceptedSettlementCompleted, CompletionDateTime, Initiation: {...} } }
